KAMELEOON_SITE_CODE.description: Not a credential: it names the project and authenticates nothing, and Kameleoon's browser and server SDKs take the identical value. Kameleoon splits identifier from credential rather than client from server.

KAMELEOON_CLIENT_ID.description: Half of the API credential pair, which appears only in the server SDK and the REST APIs, never in a browser sample.

KAMELEOON_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The other half. Generating a new one is offered; whether the old stops working at once is not stated.
